---
title: "Highlights"
---

*Last updated on: 2026-09-15*

Since its formation in January 2026, the members of U-KREAT have published *6* papers directly related to U-KREAT. These are distributed across years and research lines as follows:

```{r distribution}
#| echo: false
# Load packages
pacman::p_load("dplyr",     # Data wrangling
               "magrittr",  # Efficient pipelines
               "tibble",    # Better data frames
               "ggplot2"    # Data visualisation
)

# Create data
dat_pubs <- tibble(
    # Year
    year = c(rep(2026, 7)),
    topic = rep(c("Acute kidney injury", "Chronic kidney disease", "Dialysis", "Kidney transplantation", "Cardio-kidney-metabolic syndrome", "Green kidney care", "Educational/methods"), 1),
    count = c(# 2026
              1, 0, 2, 0, 1, 1, 1
              )
) %>%
    # Set topic to factor
    mutate(as.factor(topic))

# Create figure
ggplot(dat_pubs,
       aes(x = as.factor(year),
           y = count,
           fill = topic)) +
    # Geometries
    geom_bar(position = "stack",
             stat = "identity") +
    # Scalings
    scale_x_discrete(name = "Year") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Number of publications",
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#8ECAE6", "#219EBC", "#126782", "#023047", "#FFB703", "#FD9E02", "#FB8500")) +
    # Guides & labels
    guides(fill = guide_legend(position = "bottom",
                               nrow = 3)) +
    labs(title = "Publication count and distribution of topics",
         subtitle = "Topics represent primary topic of paper") +
    # Aesthetics
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#EDF6F9",
                                         colour = "transparent"),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic",
                                       hjust = 0.5,
                                       size = 10),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dashed",
                                            colour = "#557A8B",
                                            linewidth = 0.1),
          axis.line = element_line(),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.background = element_blank(),
          )

```
